claims.text: ChatTf is a knowledge graph-enhanced intelligent Q&A system for Chinese traditional folklore.
The Traditional Folklore Ontology (TFOnto) was constructed to domain-model Chinese traditional folklore.
The Zero-shot Traditional Folklore Triplet Extraction (ZFTE) framework constructs a Traditional Folklore Knowledge Graph (TFKG) driven by TFOnto.
The TFKG-RAG dual-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework provides traditional folklore knowledge to large language models to reduce factuality hallucinations.
ChatTf achieved an accuracy of 96.7% on a self-built TFCQD test set.
ChatTf outperforms several state-of-the-art baseline methods on folklore domain question answering.

methodologies.name: ChatTf / TFKG-RAG Framework
methodologies.description: A dual-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework integrating a knowledge graph built via zero-shot triplet extraction and ontology modeling to answer folklore domain questions.

limitations.text: Large language models suffer from factuality hallucinations in knowledge-intensive domains due to insufficient domain knowledge.
